en: to have any concerns
examples: Please let us know if you have any concerns before the procedure.
She had several concerns, which we addressed in detail.
He was encouraged to raise any concerns at follow-up.

en: to explain in layman's terms
examples: I explained the diagnosis in layman's terms to ensure understanding.
It is important to explain procedures in layman's terms before consent.
He appreciated having the results explained in layman's terms.

en: to go through (results/options) with someone
examples: Let's go through the results together and answer any questions.
I went through the treatment options with the patient and her husband.
We went through the discharge instructions before she left the ward.

en: risks and benefits
examples: We discussed the risks and benefits of the proposed treatment.
The risks and benefits of surgery versus conservative management were outlined.
She was given time to consider the risks and benefits before deciding.

en: side effects
examples: I explained the common side effects of the new medication.
He was advised to report any side effects promptly.
No significant side effects were reported during treatment.

en: informed consent
examples: Informed consent was obtained prior to the procedure.
We discussed the risks and benefits to ensure informed consent.
The patient gave informed consent after all questions were answered.

en: Benefits and harms
pl: Korzyści i ryzyko / Zalety i wady zabiegu
examples: I explained the benefits and harms of the proposed treatment.
We discussed the benefits and harms of continuing versus stopping the medication.
The benefits clearly outweigh the potential harms in this case.

en: lifestyle advice
examples: Lifestyle advice was given regarding diet and physical activity.
We provided lifestyle advice to help reduce his cardiovascular risk.
She was receptive to the lifestyle advice offered during the consultation.

en: to break bad news
examples: Breaking bad news requires sensitivity and clear communication.
I broke the news to the family in a private, quiet room.
He was supported by a nurse while receiving the bad news.

en: to reassure
examples: I reassured her that the findings were benign.
He was reassured that this is a common and treatable condition.
We aimed to reassure the family throughout the procedure.
synonyms: to put someone's mind at rest

en: to put your mind at ease
examples: I hope this explanation has put your mind at ease.
The consultant's clear explanation put her mind at ease.
We wanted to put his mind at ease before the operation.

en: at your own pace
examples: Please read through the information at your own pace.
Recovery will happen at your own pace, so there's no need to rush.
You can ask questions at your own pace throughout the consultation.

en: to weigh up the pros and cons
examples: Take some time to weigh up the pros and cons before deciding.
We helped him weigh up the pros and cons of each treatment option.
She weighed up the pros and cons before consenting to surgery.
synonyms: to consider the advantages and disadvantages

en: to check understanding
examples: I checked her understanding by asking her to summarise the plan.
It is good practice to check understanding before ending the consultation.
He checked the patient's understanding of the medication instructions.

en: to book a follow-up appointment
examples: Please book a follow-up appointment for four weeks' time.
The receptionist will help you book a follow-up appointment on your way out.
He was asked to book a follow-up appointment if symptoms persisted.

en: is there anything you'd like to ask?
pl: czy jest coś, o co chciał(a)by Pan/Pani zapytać?
examples: Before we finish, is there anything you'd like to ask?
Is there anything you'd like to ask about the procedure itself?
I paused regularly to check: is there anything you'd like to ask?

en: Hello, I’m Dr …, one of the doctors looking after you.
pl: Dzień dobry, jestem dr …, jednym z lekarzy, którzy się Panem/Panią opiekują.
examples: Hello, I’m Dr Nowak, one of the doctors looking after you on the ward.
Good morning, I’m Dr Nowak, one of the doctors looking after your mother.

en: How would you like me to address you?
pl: Jak mam się do Pana/Pani zwracać?
examples: Before we start, how would you like me to address you?

en: I’ve been asked to talk to you about…
pl: Poproszono mnie, żebym porozmawiał(a) z Panem/Panią o…
examples: I’ve been asked to talk to you about the results of your scan.
I’ve been asked to talk to you about your medication before you go home.

en: Is now a good time to talk?
pl: Czy to dobry moment na rozmowę?
examples: Is now a good time to talk, or would you prefer to wait for your husband?

en: Can you tell me a bit more about…?
pl: Czy może Pan/Pani powiedzieć mi coś więcej o…?
examples: Can you tell me a bit more about the pain?
Can you tell me a bit more about what happened last night?

en: What do you think might be causing it?
pl: Co Pana/Pani zdaniem może być przyczyną?
examples: You mentioned the headaches get worse at work. What do you think might be causing it?

en: Is there anything in particular that’s worrying you?
examples: Is there anything in particular that’s worrying you about the operation?

en: What were you hoping we could do for you today?
pl: Na co liczył(a) Pan/Pani, przychodząc dzisiaj?
examples: What were you hoping we could do for you today?

en: So, just to make sure I’ve understood correctly…
pl: Czyli, żeby upewnić się, że dobrze zrozumiałem/zrozumiałam…
examples: So, just to make sure I’ve understood correctly, the headaches started two weeks ago and are worse in the morning?

en: What do you already know about…?
examples: What do you already know about diabetes?
Before I explain, what do you already know about the procedure?

en: Let me explain what that means.
examples: Your blood sugar is higher than it should be. Let me explain what that means.

en: How does that sound to you?
examples: We could start with tablets and see you again in a month. How does that sound to you?

en: Would you like some time to think about it?
pl: Czy chciał(a)by Pan/Pani mieć czas do namysłu?
examples: There’s no rush to decide. Would you like some time to think about it?

en: Just to recap, …
examples: Just to recap, we’ll arrange a scan and I’ll see you again in two weeks.

en: If things get worse before then, please come back straight away.
pl: Jeśli wcześniej się pogorszy, proszę od razu wrócić.
examples: If things get worse before then, please come back straight away or call 111.
